name: Personal Training
shortDescription: One-on-one coaching built around your goals.
description: Work directly with a certified trainer on a plan designed for your body, your goals, and your schedule. Every session is tracked and adjusted as you progress.
whoItsFor: Anyone who wants faster results with expert guidance and accountability.

name: Group Classes
shortDescription: High-energy sessions with a supportive community.
description: From strength circuits to HIIT, our group classes bring the energy of a crowd to push you further than you'd go alone, led by certified instructors.
whoItsFor: Members who thrive on group motivation and variety.

name: Functional Training
description: Functional training builds the kind of strength, balance, and mobility that carries over into everyday life and sport — not just the gym floor.
whoItsFor: Anyone who wants to move better, not just lift more.

name: Cardio & Endurance
description: State-of-the-art cardio equipment and structured endurance programming to build stamina, burn fat, and improve heart health at any fitness level.
whoItsFor: Members focused on endurance, weight loss, or overall conditioning.
